people.gloss: Burns the feathers to be reborn
people.role: Founder (1020) and head of Phần Vũ Đường; keeper of the Xích Hà Kỳ; a body cultivator of the vents
people.appearance: A bull-necked man with arms burned to a glossy red to the shoulder, who sits on the floor in his own hall because chairs break.
people.backstory: Hùng Phần Vũ was born in Ngũ Thải Thành in 980, and the dockside tells that a red feather fell on his cradle (A309). He grew up fighting on the wharves, learned the Mountain Heart Canon from a caravan guard, and at thirty walked inland to the vents of Chúc Dung Khẩu to see how long he could stand in them. In 1020 the palace founder Ngô Thê Đồng (ngo_the_dong) came down to the Fire Court, watched him stand in moving fire for an hour, and lent him the Xích Hà Kỳ (C177). Hùng founded the hall in the vent village five tiles from the court. In 1025 his first disciple Kê Thủ Liệt (ke_thu_liet) died at the first sitting (A310), and he wrote the outer method so that no one would sit without a way to stop. In 1162 the palace head moved her court to Hỏa Ti (N-phuong_minh-12), took the province for her seat, and asked the hall for a child as surety. His daughter Hùng Diễm Nhi (hung_diem_nhi) asked to go, and he let her. That autumn his Dao partner Tuân Hà Y (tuan_ha_y) went into the vent's mouth for the Red Wall Rebirth and did not come out (N-phan_vu-04). He forgives quickly and has forgiven everyone for 1162 except himself.
people.wants: His daughter home, and a hall that holds its own vents and is not a tenant at the palace's door.
people.secret: He did not read the Burning Feather Body off the red-stone walls. The founder gave it to him in 1020 with the banner, out of the Hall of Spoils: it is Xích Thành Môn's body canon. The one condition was that Phần Vũ never call itself Xích Thành's heir. The palace wanted the vents held by someone who owed it, and Xích Thành's arts kept where its own disciples would not be seen learning them. This spring he wrote that gift into the hall's answer to the palace's rent, one line in the lease, and the treasurer who keeps the Hall of Spoils' book knows what it means.

people.role: First elder of Phần Vũ Đường; master of the sittings; negotiates the hall's lease with the palace
people.appearance: A compact, grey-cropped man with a burned-smooth face, who listens with his head tilted as if hearing the vent.
people.backstory: Tào Tẫn Kiên was born in the vent village in 1038 and, as a boy, ran the hot rock with a girl called Thích Hồng Linh (thich_hong_linh), who is now the palace's fan master. She went up to the Fire Court; he went to Hùng Phần Vũ (hung_phan_vu), and he has sat every sitting the canon allows except the last. He runs the sittings now and has brought more disciples out of the vent than anyone, and lost more. In 1161 he put the head's daughter Hùng Diễm Nhi (hung_diem_nhi) in the vent at eleven, to show her father she was too young for the hall; she came out with her arm burned to the bone. When the palace asked for a child the next year she asked to go, and he told Hùng to let her. He plays weiqi with the palace's clerks on the Fire Court's steps whenever he rides up, and is liked there. Thích still argues that the hall should be taken in, and they have not spoken kindly since.
people.wants: To be head after Hùng, confirmed by the palace, with the vents still the hall's.
people.secret: In 1162 the palace treasurer Vưu Cẩm Thư (vuu_cam_thu) promised him, privately, that the palace would back his succession over the girl if he saw her sent. He did. Now he is settling her rent for the hall. His draft gave the palace the cooled lava where the outer gate sits and the dead stand, and names the leaseholder as the head 'whom its lord confirms'; sealed, it makes the palace's word the hall's succession. Hùng struck the lava out and added a line about the canon given with the banner in 1020, and Tào carries it up without knowing what it means.

people.role: Keeper of the Lower Mouth, the hall's sitting places on the vent's flank below the palace's Nest
people.appearance: A grey-dusted woman who smells of sulphur and keeps a knotted cord with one knot for every disciple now in the vent.
people.backstory: Trang Hôi Y counts who goes into the vent and who comes out, and ties and unties a knot for each. In 1162 she untied none for Tuân Hà Y (tuan_ha_y) and carried out what was left. She keeps the hall's sitting places on the lower flank of Chúc Dung Khẩu, a hundred paces below the palace's Nest, and settles the line between them every season with the Ash Seat's attendant Vi Tịch Hôi (vi_tich_hoi). At each dark of the moon she lets Tuân's daughter sit, and ties no knot for her.

people.role: Captain of the hall's levy; guards the road between Tang Điền and the Fire Court
people.appearance: A loud silk-trader's son with a broken nose who wears the hall's red sash over a merchant's coat.
people.backstory: A silk trader's son from Tang Điền who came to the vents to stop being a silk trader's son, Đới Liệt Cương leads the hall's levy, the strongest of any vassal of the palace. Since 1162 its work has been guarding the road to the Fire Court, and he hates it. He hates the palace's envoy Bình Viễn Khách (binh_vien_khach) more, because she counts the levy as tribute. Hùng Phần Vũ (hung_phan_vu) trained him and keeps him away from the Fire Court's gate.

people.role: Hùng Phần Vũ's Dao partner; mother of Hùng Diễm Nhi
people.backstory: A silk-dyer's daughter of Tang Điền and the hall's best fighter in her day, she was Hùng Phần Vũ's (hung_phan_vu) Dao partner for sixty years. In 1162 her daughter Hùng Diễm Nhi (hung_diem_nhi) went to the palace as its surety, at the girl's own asking. That autumn, at 102, with a Trúc Cơ that had not moved in forty years, she went into the vent's mouth for the Red Wall Rebirth to break through, and did not come out.
